say:1:1033607001:1.text: Ah, don't rush me! I hope you're not gonna start nagging us like Captain Parisa does...
say:1:1033607001:1.source_cn: 你怎么比帕瑞莎队长还着急！

say:1:1033607001:1.female: Ah, don't rush me! I hope you're not gonna start nagging us like Captain Parisa does...

say:2:1033607002:1.text: Don't worry! Since this will be a temporary shelter for refugees, I'll do my best to spruce it all up fast.
say:2:1033607002:1.source_cn: 放心吧，既然这里是提供给难民的临时居所，我一定全力以赴...

say:3:1033607003:1.text: As one of the Thorned Guards, this shall be my way of atonement. I will be meticulous!
